content.title: Sidemen Charity Match 2026 LIVE RESULT: 20-goal THRILLER decided on pens as KSI & AngryGinge score in Wembley spectacle
content.text: YOUTUBE ALL-STARS have won the Sidemen Charity Match on penalties for a second consecutive year! A sold-out Wembley Stadium were treated to a record-breaking 20-goal thriller, with KSI and AngryGinge both getting on the scoresheet. Sign up for the Football newsletter Thank you! MrWhoseTheBoss tucked away the decisive penalty for YouTube All-Stars, who won the dramatic shootout 4-1. Match result: Sidemen FC 10-10 YouTube All-Stars (1-4 pens) Donate Follow our LIVE blog below… By Nyle Smith HappyGinge AngryGinge is now a HappyGinge as he has won two out of two Sidemen Charity Matches. Bach here again Social media star Italianbach's late strike is what sent the Sidemen Charity Match to a second successive penalty shootout. By Nyle Smith Previous results Here is how each match has unfolded since the very first one. 2016: Sidemen 7-2 YouTube Allstars 2017: Sidemen 0-2 YouTube Allstars 2018: Sidemen 7-1 YouTube Allstars 2022: Sidemen 8-7 YouTube Allstars 2023: Sidemen 8-5 YouTube Allstars 2025: Sidemen 9-9 YouTube Allstars (YouTube Allstars win 5-4 on PENS) 2026: Sidemen 10-10 YouTube Allstars (YouTube Allstars win 4-1 on PENS) Sidemen summary For those who are unaware of what happened, the YouTube All-Stars have won the Sidemen Charity Match on penalties for a second consecutive year! A sold-out Wembley Stadium was treated to a record-breaking 20-goal thriller, with KSI and AngryGinge both getting on the scoresheet. MrWhoseTheBoss tucked away the decisive penalty for YouTube All-Stars, who won the dramatic shootout 4-1. And as a result, it saw the YouTube All-Stars who was captained by KSI win the thrilling contest. By Nyle Smith Will there be a Sidemen Charity Match 2027? It's no secret that the Sidemen Charity Match has been a success over the years. And yesterday proved it with over £6.2million raised for charity. However, it has not been confirmed yet whether there will be another one in 2027. But fans are hoping that KSI and Co will announce a 2027 edition soon. By Nyle Smith Magic tricks Max Fosh received a yellow card before making it burst into flames which was one of the highlights of yesterday's match. By Nyle Smith Luke Littler rejected Darts sensation Luke Littler didn't star in the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match after having his plea to play rejected by KSI. World champion Littler has collaborated with content creator group Sidemen – who have 23 million subscribers on their YouTube page – in the past, teaming up for a cereal brand in 2024. Littler, 19, openly expressed his desire to take part, tagging the group by saying: “Get me in the team Sidemen.” However, that was quickly shut down by KSI and the proof was in the pudding when Littler was nowhere to be seen. By Nyle Smith Sidemen raise a huge amount for charity The Sidemen raised a whopping £6.2million for charity after yesterday's thrilling match. And here is how KSI reacted when finding out the news. By Nyle Smith Sidemen Charity Match results And here are the results over the years including yesterday's thrilling contest. 2016: Sidemen 7-2 YouTube Allstars 2017: Sidemen 0-2 YouTube Allstars 2018: Sidemen 7-1 YouTube Allstars 2022: Sidemen 8-7 YouTube Allstars 2023: Sidemen 8-5 YouTube Allstars 2025: Sidemen 9-9 YouTube Allstars (YouTube Allstars win 5-4 on PENS) 2026: Sidemen 10-10 YouTube Allstars (YouTube Allstars win 4-1 on PENS) By Nyle Smith YouTube All-Stars star again Yesterday's result means the YouTube All-Stars have won two consecutive matches. But they are still behind the Sidemen FC in overall wins. By Nyle Smith JICYMI Just in case you missed it, the Sidemen Charity Match 2026 turned out to be a 20-goal THRILLER which went to penalties. KSI and AngryGinge both got on the scoresheet but it was MrWhoseTheBoss who calmly tucked away the decisive penalty for YouTube All-Stars. Card trick Max Fosh is well-versed in tricks against the referee in Sidemen Charity Matches, but this might be his maddest yet. Two years ago, he pulled out an UNO reverse card on ex-Prem referee Mark Clattenburg, before being booked last year and going on to SHRED the yellow card. This time, he turned into an actual on-pitch magician and set FIRE to the card he had just received. SunSport's Lloyd Canfield has footage of what actually happened! By Connor Greaves Golden boot winner Who else but Miniminter? The Sidemen member switched sides to the YouTube All-Stars and helped them to a huge win over his former team. Miniminter bagged a hat-trick at Wembley and took his tally of Sidemen Charity Match goals to 14! He is SEVEN goals clear at the top of the standings. By Connor Greaves Twenty's Plenty Yesterday's Sidemen Charity Match was the highest-scoring of all time. A total of 20 goals, split equally between the two sides, means it outscored the previous record by two goals. Last year's 9-9 draw was the highest-scoring match before Saturday's Wembley clash. By Connor Greaves Bach of the net Italianbach's late equaliser took his YouTube All-Stars side to penalties. YouTube All-Stars went on to prevail on spot kicks for a second consecutive year and his goal was of great importance. By Connor Greaves 'One of the greatest days of my life' - Danny Arrons Streaming sensation Danny Aarons was on the winning side and got his name on the scoresheet yesterday afternoon. On Instagram after the match, he posted: "One of the greatest days of my life, thank you everyone so much for showing me and all the boys so much love. "You guys and girls have genuinely made this such an unforgettable moment for me. Thank you " By Connor Greaves Trophy lift KSI was one of three members of the Sidemen to leave for YouTube All-Stars for this year's charity match. The internet sensation captained his side to victory on penalties and lifted the trophy in front of a jubilant Wembley crowd. By Connor Greaves King of Wembley! King of the Jungle, AngryGinge, went two for two in Sidemen Charity Matches this afternoon. He also added to his debut goal last year as his bullet header opened the scoring at Wembley. By Connor Greaves Managed to perfection Calfreezy's YouTube All-Stars looked down at 10-8 down with 10 minutes to go. But late goals from Miniminter and Italian Bach took the match to penalties for the second year running. Manager Calfreezy converted the first penalty with his only touch of the game. His side went on to do him proud and claim back-to-back titles. By Connor Greaves POTM reacts Jynxzi may have been on the losing side today, but he certainly put in a shift. The influencer scored two on his debut in the Sidemen Charity Match! By Connor Greaves Match stats Sidemen FC Possession - 55% Expected goals - 5.86 Shots - 22 Big chances - 11 YouTube All-Stars Possession - 45% Expected goals - 6.45 Total shots - 28 Big chances - 12 By Connor Greaves KSI reacts YouTube All-Stars captain KSI has hit back at his brother Deji after the match... By Connor Greaves KSI on why Littler didn't play Luke Littler made his intentions to play in the game clear in February, when he responded to the Sidemen's sold-out announcement with the words, "Get me in the team Sidemen." In response, KSI said pre-match: "I have not responded and he’s not in. It sounds so bad, but we only have content creators on the Sidemen Charity Match." By Connor Greaves Staggering amount raised This year's Sidemen Charity Match has raised a crazy £6,218,875 for charity! By Connor Greaves Previous Sidemen Charity Match results YouTube Allstars have made it back-to-back wins in the Sidemen Charity Match with their victory on penalties this afternoon. Sidemen FC still lead the way in the all-time records with four wins, but their rivals are breathing down their necks. 2016: Sidemen 7-2 YouTube Allstars 2017: Sidemen 0-2 YouTube Allstars 2018: Sidemen 7-1 YouTube Allstars 2022: Sidemen 8-7 YouTube Allstars 2023: Sidemen 8-5 YouTube Allstars 2025: Sidemen 9-9 YouTube Allstars (YouTube Allstars win 5-4 on PENS) 2026: Sidemen 10-10 YouTube Allstars (Youtube Allstars win 4-1 on PENS) By Connor Greaves Sidemen Charity Match all-time leading scorers Miniminter's hat-trick has extended his lead as the top scorer in Sidemen Charity Match history! 1st - Miniminter 14 goals 2nd - Manny 7 goals 3rd TBJZL 6 goals 4th ChrisMD 5 goals 5th Theo Baker 4 goals By Connor Greaves Fans left amazed as Max Fosh SETS FIRE to yellow card Max Fosh is well-versed in tricks against the referee in Sidemen Charity Matches, but this might be his maddest yet. Two years ago, he pulled out an UNO reverse card on ex-Prem referee Mark Clattenburg, before being booked last year and going on to SHRED the yellow card. This time, he turned into an actual on-pitch magician and set FIRE to the card he had just received. With internet sensation Marlon Garcia driving through midfield, Strictly star George Clarke attempted to pull him down before he was finally rugby-tackled to the floor by Fosh. Clattenburg, of course, made a point of making sure he was booked. He called Fosh over and dished out the yellow. Fosh, though, shocked everyone inside Wembley Stadium and watching at home, when he grabbed the card from the referee and showed the crowd, before somehow incinerating it in front of 90,000 people. By Connor Greaves The all-important penalty MrWhoseTheBoss had nerves of steel in front of a sold-out Wembley as he slotted away the winning penalty for YouTube All-Stars. By Connor Greaves Today's goal scorers Here are all the goal scorers from the 20-GOAL thriller: Sidemen FC TBJZL 13' Garcia 16' ChrisMD 35' Jynxzi 38', 79' Shabeel 54' (Pen) Zerkaa 57' Vikkstar123 67' AB 71' Niko 77' YouTube All-Stars AngryGinge 7' Miniminter 29', 45', 84' ItalianBach 40', 87' Danny Aarons 48' NYKchazza 50' WillNE 64' KSI 75' By Connor Greaves Huge amount raised for charity KSI has just revealed that this year's Sidemen Charity Match has raised a mammoth £6,218,875! The crazy amount will go to support Bright Side and M7 Education. By Connor Greaves Celebrations flowing YouTube All-Stars captain KSI has now taken to the pitch with his teammates to lift the trophy once again. The players are now taking it in turns to lift their prize in front of jubilant fans. By Connor Greaves Crowning moment KSI, another Sidemen member who made the switch to the YouTube All-Stars, lifts the trophy for the All-Stars! By Connor Greaves Miniminter wins the Golden Boot The Sidemen member made the switch to the YouTube All-Stars for the first time and bagged a hat-trick. Wise choice. By Connor Greaves Both teams heading up the steps Sidemen FC are heading up to collect their runners-up medals while YouTube All-Stars are preparing to lift the trophy. By Connor Greaves Jynxzi wins Player Of The Match Jynxzi bagged a brace during the Sidemen Charity Match and put in a sterling performance at Wembley. A deserved POTM. By Daniel Clark YouTube Allstars wins it on penalties! An absolute disaster from Sidemen FC, who missed their first three penalties, giving the Allstars plenty of room to breathe. An Incredible game from start to finish, and both sets of players can be proud of their performances. By Daniel Clark PENALTIES Sidemen FC 1-4 YouTube Allstars MRwhosetheboss scores and wins it for the Allstars! By Daniel Clark PENALTIES Sidemen FC 1-3 YouTube Allstars ChrisMD scores! By Daniel Clark PENALTIES Sidemen FC 0-3 YouTube Allstars Max Fosh scores! By Daniel Clark PENALTIES Sidemen FC 0-2 YouTube Allstars LazarBeam Misses! By Daniel Clark PENALTIES Sidemen FC 0-2YouTube Allstars Ibai scores By Daniel Clark PENALTIES Sidemen FC 0-1 YouTube Allstars The other manager, Jack Joseph, MISSES By Daniel Clark PENALTIES Sidemen FC 0-1 YouTube Allstars The Manager Calfreezy steps up and scores! By Daniel Clark Penalties to decide the winner What a match we've seen today, and now to top it off, a penalty shoot-out, you can't ask for much better. By Daniel Clark FULL TIME: Sidemen FC 10-10 YouTube Allstars We're going to penalties! By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 10-10 YouTube Allstars 87. And we're all square. Not long left to go now, and ItalianBach has a great shot from outside the box, and it goes past XQC pretty easily. Looks like we're going to penalties. By Daniel Clark GOAL: ITALIANBACH By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 10-9 YouTube Allstars 83. Hat-trick hero Miniminter! The all-time top goal scorer in these Charity Matches is having another great outing as he scores his third goal of the game. There's just one goal in it now. By Daniel Clark GOAL: MINIMINTER By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 10-8 YouTube Allstars 79. Jynxzi gets his second! With just 10 minutes to go, that two-goal gap could be costly for the Allstars. By Daniel Clark GOAL: JYNXZI By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 9-8 YouTube Allstars 78. Niko gets Sidemen FC back in front. This match is chaos, and the goals are just flying in from all angles. By Daniel Clark GOAL: NIKO By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 8-8 YouTube Allstars 75. And the score is level again! KSI made a great run at the backpost and was wide open for a pass. He finally gets the ball, and the shot isn't great, but it still gets past XQC. By Daniel Clark GOAL: KSI By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 8-7 YouTube Allstars 72. What a goal from AB! He whips it from a tight angle into the top corner; that was some real quality there. And after an on-field review looking at a handball, the goal still stands. By Daniel Clark GOAL: AB By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 7-7 YouTube Allstars 67. Vikkstar gets his goal, and the crowd are loving it! Sidemen FC play it well and get the ball in a dangerous area, it's the square to a wide-open Vikk, and he slots it well. By Daniel Clark GOAL: VIKKSTAR! By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 6-7 YouTube Allstars 65. A goalmouth scramble after the ball is played in from a corner, and WillNE is there at the back post. He takes his opportunity and gets his side back in front. By Daniel Clark GOAL: WILLNE By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 6-6 YouTube Allstars 63. Ethan Behzinga has taken a more advanced role here in the second, and he's getting the Allstars more of an attack. He's made a big positive impact. By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 6-6 YouTube Allstars 60. We've got just over half an hour left to go. It's a very even match here, and plenty of goals yet to come. You'd expect this to go to penalties, but we'll wait and see. By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 6-6 YouTube Allstars 57. And we're all square! It's Sidemen's very own Josh Zerkaa who finds himself in the box and slots it home. Everyone's getting a share of the goals here. By Daniel Clark GOAL: ZERKAA By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 5-6 YouTube Allstars 53. After an on-field review, Clattenberg awards a penalty after Shabeel is fouled in the area. The Beta Squad member takes the penalty himself and slots it into the top corner past Sketch. By Daniel Clark GOAL: AJ SHABEEL By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 4-6 YouTube Allstars 50. The Allstars go two goals in front! KSI, adjusting his shorts, plays a great ball over the top to Chazza and, on his weaker foot, manages to squeeze it past XQC. By Daniel Clark GOAL: NYKCHAZZA By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 4-5 YouTube Allstars 48. The YouTube Allstars take the lead for the first time in the match! The ball is played through to Aarons and he lots it past XQC with ease. By Daniel Clark GOAL DANNY AARONS By Daniel Clark Sidemen FC 4-4 YouTube Allstars 46. Another Max Fosh yellow card trick! As the British YouTuber takes out Marlon, Clattenberg takes out his yellow card. He then grabs the yellow card and sets it on fire? Comments
